title: Recto is a free canvas for what a coding agent draws
friendlyTitle: Recto lets you edit what a coding agent draws
summary: Recto 0.1.8, released 8 November, runs locally on Mac, Windows, and Linux. It detects coding agents already on the machine, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, and lets you move, restyle, or send a comment back to the agent. Designs are HTML and CSS, and the download is free.
friendlySummary: Recto is a free app for Mac, Windows, and Linux. It works with coding agents already on your computer. You can move things on the page, or send a note back to the agent. The result is ordinary HTML and CSS.
whyItMatters: The usual loop is a prompt, a browser, a screenshot, and another prompt. A canvas lets you point at the element instead of describing it. Recto does not replace the agent, and it does not require an MCP setup.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Usually you describe a change in words, then look at a screenshot. Here you can point at the part you mean. It does not replace the agent.
